metadata.source: ChatGPT expert (gpt-5.4 thinking) via Vesara triple-brain · 4 parallel batches
metadata.occupancy_truth_standard: Guesty hostPayout > 0, source != owner/manual, blocked-listing filter applied

properties.name: Spacious 4BR Sparks Home · Patio by Willowcreek Park
properties.top_fix_1: Raise base from $369 to $379-$389 and hold min at $215; current 80% 30-day occupancy vs 47% market indicates underpricing on peak dates.
properties.top_fix_2: Audit weekend and event compression pricing in PriceLabs; increase far-out premiums and last-room-value settings to capture stronger ADR without sacrificing occupancy.
properties.top_fix_3: Refresh hero photos and first 3 listing captions around patio, park adjacency, and group-friendly layout to defend premium positioning.
properties.biggest_win: Best revenue/occupancy profile in the set; materially outperforming market while pricing is still close to recommendation.
properties.biggest_concern: High occupancy can mask ADR leakage; likely leaving money on the table during peak demand windows.

properties.name: Chic 1BR Reno · Heated Pool, Spa & Sauna
properties.top_fix_1: Continue the +5% test (active May 5-18) and likely push another 5-8% if occupancy stays above 85%; 100% occupancy means current pricing is too cheap.
properties.top_fix_2: Raise base from $159 toward $167-175 despite low PriceLabs signal; low signal at full occupancy is not actionable.
properties.top_fix_3: Increase max above $295 for peak dates and verify weekend/event multipliers are aggressive enough.
properties.biggest_win: 100% occupancy versus 47% market is elite demand capture and strongest pricing power in the set.
properties.biggest_concern: Underpricing risk is high; perfect occupancy is usually a revenue optimization failure, not a victory.

properties.name: 3BR Family Home in Reno · Patio & Near Downtown
properties.top_fix_1: Increase base from $209 to $219-$225 and tighten discounts on high-demand weekends; 73% occupancy vs 48% market supports ADR expansion.
properties.top_fix_2: Add stronger family-use merchandising in first 5 photos and amenities section to reinforce why this 3BR wins versus Reno comps.
properties.top_fix_3: Review minimum-stay strategy for peak weekends and event dates; likely room to push 2-3 night controls without hurting occupancy.
properties.biggest_win: Excellent occupancy outperformance with pricing still near recommendation; strong evidence of product-market fit.
properties.biggest_concern: Like LOS1191, success may be hiding ADR leakage if demand compression dates are not being monetized aggressively enough.

properties.name: Cozy 1BR Near Lake Tahoe · Heated Pool & Spa Access
properties.top_fix_1: Raise base price from $135 to $138-145 to align with demand and PriceLabs recommendation; current 70% occupancy vs 47% market supports ADR lift.
properties.top_fix_2: Audit min stay, orphan gap, and last-minute discounts to avoid leaving money on the table on high-demand dates.
properties.top_fix_3: Strengthen title/photo order around pool/spa access and Tahoe proximity while staying geographically accurate; avoid overselling Tahoe for a Reno asset.
properties.biggest_win: Occupancy outperforms market by 23 points with pricing close to recommendation.
properties.biggest_concern: Base rate is slightly under market-supported level, suggesting ADR leakage.

properties.name: Hot Tub, Gym, Pool, Mini Golf | 1BR Apartment
properties.top_fix_1: RETRACTED 2026-05-05: Prior 'raise base on strong occupancy' rec was based on stale PriceLabs data (PL 80% vs Guesty truth 13%). Real occ is 13% — investigate listing health, channel distribution, and pricing floor. Run full audit before any pricing move.
properties.top_fix_2: Audit Airbnb/Vrbo channel status — 67pp PL/Guesty delta indicates listing may be paused, hidden, or owner-blocked on key channels.
properties.top_fix_3: Pull the last 60 days of inquiries vs bookings to identify conversion failure point (no inquiries = visibility issue; inquiries no bookings = listing/price issue).
properties.biggest_win: 80% occupancy versus 47% market is clear outperformance with pricing already near recommended base.
properties.biggest_concern: STALE DATA RETRACTION: prior scorecard built on PriceLabs occupancy (80%) which materially overstated actual paying-revenue occupancy (13%). Score may need full re-derivation.

properties.name: Modern 2BR in Sparks · Jacuzzi, Pool & Mountain Views
properties.top_fix_1: Reconnect or validate PriceLabs immediately; running without a recommendation while outperforming market creates avoidable revenue leakage risk.
properties.top_fix_2: Increase base from $235 to $245-$255 and widen high-demand date premiums; occupancy is +13 pts over market.
properties.top_fix_3: Package pool + mountain views visually in first 5 photos and test title variants to support a higher rate ceiling.
properties.biggest_win: Best occupancy spread in the set at 57% vs 44% market — strong product-market fit and likely underpricing.
properties.biggest_concern: No active PriceLabs recommendation on a top-performing unit is an asset-management control failure.

properties.name: Luxury 2BR/2BA Reno Apartment · Pool, Spa & Theater
properties.top_fix_1: RETRACTED 2026-05-05: Prior recs assumed 63-67% occupancy (PL). Guesty truth is 12% on a 60-day window. This is an underperformer, not a stable performer.
properties.top_fix_2: Channel distribution audit — 44pp PL/Guesty delta is symptomatic of channel-level outage or owner block.
properties.top_fix_3: Compare against ALX223/ALX1021 clone-set siblings; if all 3 show similar Guesty truth, the issue is portfolio-level not unit-level.
properties.biggest_win: Healthy balance of occupancy outperformance and under-market base relative to recommendation gives easy ADR upside.
properties.biggest_concern: STALE DATA RETRACTION: prior scorecard built on PriceLabs occupancy that overstated reality by 44pp.

properties.name: Stylish 4BR Sparks Home Near Golden Eagle Sports
properties.top_fix_1: Move base from $310 to $317-325 in line with PriceLabs rec; current pricing is slightly soft relative to demand.
properties.top_fix_2: Strengthen sports-travel positioning in title, first 5 photos, and description; Golden Eagle proximity should be merchandised harder for tournament demand.
properties.top_fix_3: Review LOS, gap-night, and orphan-night rules to improve shoulder-date pickup around sports weekends.
properties.biggest_win: Healthy occupancy at 57% vs 46% market with pricing close to recommended level.
properties.biggest_concern: Good but not dominant; likely missing conversion and ADR upside from weak niche positioning.

properties.name: Serene 1BR Reno · Sauna, Pool & Yoga Studio
properties.top_fix_1: Urgently reconnect or repair PriceLabs integration; null recommendation is a revenue management control failure.
properties.top_fix_2: Reduce base from $189 to $169-179 unless verified premium review strength; 90% occupancy could indicate undersupplied calendar.
properties.top_fix_3: Check availability constraints and blocked dates because high occupancy with relatively low YTD revenue can indicate limited bookable inventory.
properties.biggest_win: Massive occupancy outperformance at 90% vs 47% market shows strong demand capture.
properties.biggest_concern: No active PriceLabs recommendation and low YTD revenue create risk that pricing/inventory controls are broken.

properties.name: Bright 1BR South Reno · Pool, Gym & Free Parking
properties.top_fix_1: Raise base from $119 to $129-139 in steps; 80% occupancy at this ADR is too cheap unless reviews or quality are weak.
properties.top_fix_2: Set a firmer weekend/event premium and lift max above $250 if booking pace holds.
properties.top_fix_3: Since PriceLabs rec is null, manually comp this against ALX1433/1734/223 and nearby 1BRs to establish a defensible floor and ceiling.
properties.biggest_win: Strong occupancy at the lowest base in the set gives immediate ADR upside.
properties.biggest_concern: Missing PriceLabs recommendation plus low base rate creates high risk of systematic underpricing.

properties.name: Sparks Marina 1BR · Waterfront Views & Rooftop Patio
properties.top_fix_1: Build 3-step arrival flow (visual guide + post-arrival ping + lock code timing audit) to lift check-in 4.77 → 4.90+.
properties.top_fix_2: Repackage value perception (4.77/5) without ADR cut: restructure $60 cleaning fee + 'no checkout chores' line + bundling line.
properties.top_fix_3: Push response rate 75% → 100% + activate Vrbo channel.
properties.biggest_win: 5.0/5 cleanliness + 5.0/5 accuracy + 5.0/5 location is elite trust foundation. Beats market occupancy.
properties.biggest_concern: Check-in score 4.77 + 75% review response = trust signals leaking despite elite ratings.
properties.scorecard_note: Original Vesara test target — first scorecard generated this morning

properties.name: Stunning Water View 1BR · Jacuzzi & Rooftop Lounge
properties.top_fix_1: Raise base from $255 to $259-269 and hold min at $195; occupancy is +4 pts over market — slightly under-monetizing demand.
properties.top_fix_2: Title/hero image should lead with waterfront + rooftop lounge; current title buries strongest conversion drivers.
properties.top_fix_3: Audit review themes and resolve any repeat cleanliness/check-in friction; performing but not yet at premium-conversion level.
properties.biggest_win: Occupancy beats market 47% vs 43% with base aligned to PriceLabs rec — healthy demand and room to push ADR.
properties.biggest_concern: Revenue decent but likely leaving money on the table through conservative pricing.

properties.name: 39th-Floor Penthouse · Ocean Views · Gaslamp Quarter
properties.top_fix_1: RE-ANCHORED 2026-05-05: Real Guesty occupancy is 17% (PL said 53%). With $449 hard floor and high-rate market position, this is expected for SD luxury — but the gap to recommendation needs review.
properties.top_fix_2: Hold $449 floor (PERMANENT_RULE — never below). Review weekend ADR pickup and Comic-Con (T-78d) and Hot August Nights (T-91d) windows.
properties.top_fix_3: Pull SD719 + SD3902 head-to-head to confirm SD market structural weakness vs property-level issues.
properties.biggest_win: Beats San Diego market occupancy 2x. Penthouse asset with $549/$549/$599/$499 floor enforcement working.
properties.biggest_concern: Real occupancy lower than scorecard implied. Penthouse asset must be defended on rate, not occupancy — but 17% is a watchlist signal.
properties.data_confidence: MEDIUM — luxury floor expected to compress occupancy; verify against SD comp set

properties.name: Scenic 2BR with Mountain Views · Jacuzzi & Pool
properties.top_fix_1: Raise base modestly from $225 to $229-239; occupancy is +3 pts over market and PriceLabs rec already supports $227.
properties.top_fix_2: Sharpen listing differentiation beyond 'mountain views' by emphasizing exact guest use cases: remote work, family layout.
properties.top_fix_3: Review photo sequencing and captioning; solid performer but not extracting enough premium from occupancy edge.
properties.biggest_win: Healthy occupancy beat at 47% vs 44% market with pricing very close to recommendation.
properties.biggest_concern: Good but not dominant; without stronger listing differentiation this unit risks becoming a commodity 2BR.

properties.name: Relaxing 2BR Reno · Hot Tub, Pool & Mountain Views
properties.top_fix_1: RETRACTED 2026-05-05: Prior recs assumed 53-77% occupancy (PL). Guesty truth is 10% on a 60-day window. Clone-set underperformer alongside ALX223/ALX1021/ALX322.
properties.top_fix_2: Channel distribution audit — 37pp PL/Guesty delta is symptomatic of channel-level outage or owner block.
properties.top_fix_3: Re-merchandise differentiation against the other Alexander 1BR units; clone-set parity is killing conversion.
properties.biggest_win: Healthy balance of occupancy and revenue for a 2BR with room to raise ADR.
properties.biggest_concern: STALE DATA RETRACTION: prior scorecard built on PriceLabs occupancy that overstated reality by 37pp.

properties.name: Fun 4BR Reno Home · Game Room, BBQ & Trampoline
properties.top_fix_1: Do not blindly follow the PriceLabs drop to $253; instead test a controlled reduction to $299-309 and monitor 14-day pickup, because trailing occupancy is already above market.
properties.top_fix_2: Audit future pace by stay date and booking window; the -22% PriceLabs recommendation likely reflects weakening forward demand rather than current conversion.
properties.top_fix_3: Merchandise game room, BBQ, and trampoline more aggressively in thumbnails and captions to preserve family/group differentiation if pricing softens.
properties.biggest_win: Current 30-day occupancy beats market, so the asset is still converting despite model pressure to discount.
properties.biggest_concern: Signals conflict: if forward pace is weak, current pricing may be too high for upcoming dates.
properties.scorecard_note: Awaiting Marina pricing decision (3 options surfaced: hold / -7% / -15%)

properties.name: Sparks 1BR Near Casinos · Jacuzzi, Pool & Views
properties.top_fix_1: Reconnect pricing automation; null PriceLabs rec is unacceptable for a unit sitting at 43% occupancy vs 44% market.
properties.top_fix_2: Benchmark directly against sister unit WAT340 and port over whatever is driving the $5K YTD outperformance: photos, title order, amenity framing, or review quality.
properties.top_fix_3: Test a slight base reduction to $229-232 or stronger weekday discounts if pace remains below market.
properties.biggest_win: Outperforms sister property WAT340 by $5K YTD despite lower base rate — stronger listing appeal or better guest experience.
properties.biggest_concern: Current occupancy slightly below market — YTD win may be historical momentum rather than current strength.

properties.name: Stylish 1BR Reno Getaway · Pool, Gym & Movie Theater
properties.top_fix_1: Hold base near $129-135 but improve conversion through listing optimization; pricing is not the primary issue with occupancy exactly at market.
properties.top_fix_2: Re-sequence first 5 photos to lead with strongest amenity differentiators: pool, gym, movie theater, workspace/sleep setup.
properties.top_fix_3: Review cleaning fee, total price competitiveness, and cancellation policy because parity occupancy usually means weak click-to-book conversion.
properties.biggest_win: Pricing is disciplined and nearly identical to PriceLabs recommendation.
properties.biggest_concern: Only matching market occupancy means no competitive edge despite strong amenity package.

properties.name: Waterfront 2BR Walk to Casinos · Jacuzzi & IMAX
properties.top_fix_1: Do not raise base above $279 until conversion improves; occupancy trails market 43% vs 44% even while pricing matches recommendation.
properties.top_fix_2: Rework listing positioning: 'Walk to Casinos' is useful, but 'IMAX' is a weak lead amenity unless it is a true in-unit differentiator with strong photos.
properties.top_fix_3: Tighten operations on turns and guest messaging to improve review velocity; underperformance at market pricing usually means listing or experience drag.
properties.biggest_win: Pricing discipline is correct; base matches PriceLabs recommendation, so the problem is diagnosable without guessing.
properties.biggest_concern: This is a conversion problem, not a pricing problem. If occupancy is below market at recommended pricing, the listing/experience stack is underperforming.

properties.name: Family 3BR Reno Home · Patio, BBQ & Near Casinos
properties.top_fix_1: Reduce base from $240 to $229-239 short term and increase gap-filler/last-minute discounts; occupancy at 37% vs 47% market is too soft.
properties.top_fix_2: Rework family positioning with sharper merchandising: patio, BBQ, parking, sleeping layout, kid suitability.
properties.top_fix_3: Verify house-rule friction and local compliance disclosures for a 3BR house; excessive deposits, chore lists, or checkout burden can hurt conversion.
properties.biggest_win: 3BR house format has stronger absolute revenue potential than the 1BR set if conversion is fixed.
properties.biggest_concern: Underperforming market occupancy despite only modest overpricing suggests weak positioning or guest-friction issues.

properties.name: Downtown San Diego King Suite · Sauna & Pool Access
properties.top_fix_1: Do not cut price materially; PriceLabs rec is $292 and market occupancy is already matched by pricing logic. Fix conversion, not ADR.
properties.top_fix_2: Audit legality and listing compliance for San Diego STR rules, HOA/building restrictions, amenity claims, and disclosure language.
properties.top_fix_3: Rebuild the first impression: stronger lead photo, clearer downtown location framing, and proof that sauna/pool access is real, convenient, and guest-usable.
properties.biggest_win: Pricing is not the issue. Base at $295 is effectively on recommendation, which narrows the problem to listing quality, channel performance, or operational drag.
properties.biggest_concern: 23% occupancy vs 26% market in San Diego is weak; if compliance, building rules, parking, or access friction exist, they are killing conversion.

properties.name: Spacious 2BR Reno Apartment · Pool, Theater & Gym
properties.top_fix_1: Cut base from $179 to $169-174 and tighten min to $129-135 until 30d occupancy clears 45%.
properties.top_fix_2: Rebuild title/hero stack to lead with strongest conversion drivers: 2BR, pool, gym, theater, parking, South Reno access.
properties.top_fix_3: Audit cleaning fee, total-stay price, and gap-night discounts; underperformance suggests weak click-to-book conversion, not just rate.
properties.biggest_win: 2BR format gives stronger revenue ceiling than the 1BR set if pricing and merchandising are corrected.
properties.biggest_concern: 37% occupancy versus 47% market means demand capture is materially weak despite only slight overpricing.

properties.name: Modern 1BR Reno Retreat · Pool, Spa & Mountain Views
properties.top_fix_1: Drop base from $159 to $149-155 and widen discounting on near-term vacancy until occupancy recovers above market.
properties.top_fix_2: Differentiate this 1BR from the Alexander clone set with sharper first 5 photos and clearer parking/workspace/location value.
properties.top_fix_3: Check all-in price competitiveness including cleaning and fees; 37% occupancy with near-market base suggests conversion friction.
properties.biggest_win: PriceLabs recommendation is close to current base, so a modest pricing reset may recover demand quickly.
properties.biggest_concern: One of the weakest performers in the set at 37% occupancy with no obvious rate premium justification.

properties.name: Chic 2BR Reno Stay · Heated Pool, Mini Golf & Sauna
properties.top_fix_1: Immediate underperformance triage: occupancy is 30% vs 47% market, so cut base from $210 to $189-199 for 14-21 days and widen last-minute discounts.
properties.top_fix_2: Audit listing for conversion blockers: weak lead photo, excessive fees, restrictive cancellation, poor bed map clarity, or amenity inaccuracies.
properties.top_fix_3: Run operational root-cause review in Guesty/Breezeway: response time, unresolved maintenance, cleaning issues, blocked calendar, and review sentiment from last 90 days.
properties.biggest_win: Base price is aligned with PriceLabs recommendation, so the issue is likely conversion or operations rather than headline ADR.
properties.biggest_concern: Occupancy collapse of 17 points below market is severe and indicates a non-pricing failure or a pricing strategy not reacting fast enough.

properties.name: 3BR Reno Home · 40 Min to Lake Tahoe, Near Downtown
properties.top_fix_1: Reset pricing architecture: keep base near $179-185 but lower near-term floor selectively below $149 on distressed dates.
properties.top_fix_2: Fix positioning immediately: '40 Min to Lake Tahoe' is weak and can feel misleading; lead with actual Reno demand drivers and neighborhood convenience.
properties.top_fix_3: Review bedroom count competitiveness, amenity parity, and photo quality against top Reno 3BR comps; this listing likely loses on perceived value before price.
properties.biggest_win: Base rate is already aligned with PriceLabs, so underperformance is probably more solvable through listing quality and market fit than through broad discounting alone.
properties.biggest_concern: STALE DATA NOTE: prior 23% occ_30d was directionally correct but Guesty 60d truth is 10% — underperformance is more severe than scorecard showed. Existing F-grade and triage rec stands.
properties.data_confidence: LOW — confirmed underperformer, exact severity worse than displayed

properties.name: Charming 4BR Reno Home · Fireplace & Near Downtown
properties.top_fix_1: Emergency recovery: cut base from $340 to $309-319 for the next 14-21 days and widen discounting on near-term orphan/gap nights; 17% occupancy vs 45% market is a visibility or conversion failure, not a minor variance.
properties.top_fix_2: Full listing teardown within 48 hours: replace cover photo, rewrite title and first paragraph, and reorder gallery to lead with strongest common areas and fireplace.
properties.top_fix_3: Run operational quality audit: check review recency, cancellation history, cleaning issues, maintenance tickets, check-in friction, and channel suppression; if there are recent sub-5-star reviews or host cancellations, address immediately.
properties.biggest_win: PriceLabs recommendation is close to current base, so the issue is likely fixable through merchandising and operational correction rather than a total pricing reset.
properties.biggest_concern: Occupancy collapse to 17% while market is 45% is a major red flag; probable listing quality, reputation, or channel-ranking problem.
properties.scorecard_note: 🚨 CRITICAL — needs Marina decision this week
